title: EcoCard: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Friends
summary: EcoCard Referral Program: you earn 50 for each successful referral, with up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year. Referrals must be approved and spend at least $500 within 60 days of account opening; bonuses typically post 1–2 billing cycles after the $500 requirement is met.
faqs: How much do I earn for each successful EcoCard referral?
What is the maximum number of referral bonuses I can earn per calendar year?
What does my friend need to do to qualify for the referral bonus (approval and $500 spend within 60 days)?
How do I make sure the referral is tracked to me (use my referral link or code when they apply)?
When will my referral bonus post after my friend meets the $500 requirement?
How can I help my referral meet the $500 within 60 days requirement? (activation and recurring bills)
keywords: Up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year
Track annual count to stay within the 7 limit
